blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — Agriculture officials in Quezon province have strengthened coordination to prepare for El Niño and ensure continued support for farmers and fisherfolk. The Quezon chapter of the League of Municipal Agriculture Officers, Municipal and City Agriculturists of the Philippines, Inc. (LEMMCAP) met in Lucena on Oct. 1 and 2 to tackle potential projects and interventions to help mitigate the effects of El Niño, the provincial government’s Public Information Office (PIO) reported. The phenomenon is now affecting 14 of the country’s 18 regions, with the agriculture sector sustaining an estimated P6.87 billion in damage, according to a DA report in […]...
